agent_explanation: Floor bounce injects energy: restitution impulse (e=0.5) plus gravity/positional correction are combined incorrectly, causing post-bounce speed 28.96 m/s vs pre-bounce 18.34 m/s, doubling kinetic+potential energy from ~176 J to 427 J with zero controller work. Removing gravity eliminates the spurious gain (counterfactual passes), indicating gravity-coupled collision handling bug.
